slug: 2024-03-28 Government Extends Deadline for Obtaining National Identity Cards

systems.system: National, ECOWAS and Non-National ID cards with the NIN
systems.country_label: ID Cards (National, ECOWAS, and Non-National); NIN
systems.tiers: Obtained at NCRA offices or designated centres across the country; deadline extended from 31 March to 28 June 2024 by a notice of 28 March 2024, with enforcement from 1 July 2024; the card and NIN are required for services including vital events registration

note: An identity card deadline; vital events registration is named only as a service that requires the card.
